name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Titan goes with exactly two of Cho, Forge, and 5 ly.
Either Lumen goes with 5 ly or 5 ly goes with Cho.
The colonist in the Lumen module's distance is higher than both Okafor and the colonist from Titan.
Lumen goes with 9 ly if and only if Callisto goes with Lumen.
